plan.understanding: Create matching repeated slot openings across the black plastic upper and lower rails identified by the dataset top and bottom views.

subtasks.goal: Change the anchor before cutting: treat the imported part's geometric top and bottom as the two opposing outer planar faces at z=+266.7 mm and z=-266.7 mm, both centered at x=-88.9 mm (measured planar faces #24 and #42), rather than the previously used ±Y side-rail planes. The other prominent opposing pair at z=±133.35 mm consists of already heavily perforated BSPLINE surfaces, so it is not the outer top/bottom pair. Isolate s0 and record its own pre-edit validity and free-edge state independently of the invalid 20-body compound; if necessary, apply tolerance-preserving shape repair/sewing to s0 without changing its envelope. On each outer ±Z face, create an 11-slot linear pattern with centers at x=-88.9 mm and y=[-127.0,-101.6,-76.2,-50.8,-25.4,0,25.4,50.8,76.2,101.6,127.0] mm, using the measured 25.4 mm spacing and ±127 mm surface envelope. Each slot is a closed capsule in the world XY plane, major axis parallel to world X, overall length 25.4 mm and width 6.35 mm, using the measured existing feature radius r=3.175 mm; its X limits are -101.6 to -76.2 mm, with semicircle centers at x=-98.425 and -79.375 mm joined by tangent lines. Form localized through-wall cutters only across the measured end-wall layers: z=257.075 to 266.8 mm for the +Z side and z=-266.8 to -257.075 mm for the -Z side, based on the outer planes at ±266.7 mm and opposing inner planar faces at ±257.175 mm. Use explicit prism solids and subtract a compound of the 11 mutually disjoint cutters from each side in one robust boolean per side, rather than repeating 22 accumulated cuts. Confirm by geometric intersection that each capsule crosses material before committing the boolean. Preserve all other regions of s0, restore untouched s1-s19 in their original order, and verify 11 matching capsule openings on each of the two ±Z outer faces, X-parallel major axes, unchanged assembly bounding box, unchanged solid count, and no increase in s0's baseline free-edge or validity defects. Report the achieved centers and actual removed volume calculated from the before/after s0 volumes.
